newsitem.title: USA: PSE&G says 18,277 in NJ lost power due storm.
newsitem.headline: PSE&G says 18,277 in NJ lost power due storm.

text.p: Public Service Electric & Gas Co (PSE&G) said an overnight storm disrupted power to 18,227 of its 2.2 million New Jersey customers, but services to all those customers were restored early Wednesday.

The heavy winds and rain--remnants of Tropical Storm Josephine--knocked down trees and overhead power lines Tuesday but did not damage PSE&G's high-voltage transmission system, said PSE&G spokesman George Koodray.
"They were scattered (outages) throughout the state," he said, adding Union County was one of the hardest hit areas.
PSE&G, Based in Newark, N.J., is a subsidiary of Public Service Enterprise Group Inc.
